description.value: Alouette Bistro is a classic French bistro located inside the Executive Hotel Le Soleil in the heart of downtown Vancouver, blending 18th-century Parisian design with modern BC ingredients. Signature dishes like Duck Cassoulet and Steak Frites honour French tradition while drawing on local flavours. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and the restaurant also accommodates private dining events.
